title: Blend Cursor
summary: A small dot replaces the mouse cursor, trails it with a little weight, and swells into a labelled disc over projects and the reel, inverting whatever it covers.
useWhen: design studio index page with a list of project names
portfolio where hovering a project should say what clicking does (View, Play)
monochrome site that needs one pointer flourish without adding colour
agency homepage with a showreel tile
techniques: pointerover event delegation with data attributes

whyItWorks.how: pointermove only stores the target. The loop closes 18 percent of the gap per frame (--cursor-lerp: 0.18), so the dot trails by a few frames and smooths hand jitter. That factor is near the top of the useful range on purpose; a cursor that lags more than that starts to feel broken. The loop sleeps once the error is under 0.1px.

The disc is always 104px (--cursor-disc) and only its scale changes, 0.096 as a 10px dot, about 0.42 over nav links and 1 over projects. Growth is a 280ms transform transition with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), so it retargets mid-flight when you sweep across rows and never resizes a box.

The disc grows only where clicking does something, and its label names the action: View on project rows, Play on the reel, Write on the email link. Plain links get a small unlabelled disc. The label fades in 80ms after the growth starts so it never appears on a still-small dot.

The custom cursor is a pointer-only flourish behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) plus a pointerType check, and the native cursor returns everywhere else. Everything the cursor hints at also exists without it. Rows slide their title 14px on both :hover and :focus-visible, nav underlines draw on both, and the reel has a visible play glyph and label.

The page is black on warm paper with one coloured tile. mix-blend-mode difference inverts what is under the disc, so the effect needs no new colour and stays legible over both the type and the gradient reel.

directions.name: Editorial
directions.change: Swap difference for a solid ink disc with paper-coloured italic serif labels, and slow --cursor-lerp to 0.12 so it drifts like a reading lamp over long article lists.

directions.name: Playful
directions.change: Give each project a data-color and tint the disc with it instead of blending, and squash the dot along its velocity (scaleX from speed) for a rubbery trail.

directions.name: Media-led
directions.change: Show a small gradient thumbnail of the project inside the disc on rows, clipped by border-radius, so the list previews work without thumbnails in the layout.

pitfalls: Hiding the native cursor with cursor: none for every device leaves touch and pen users with no cursor at all. Gate it on the media query and only after the script has started.
Growing the cursor by animating width and height reflows every frame. Keep one size and scale it.
Putting mix-blend-mode on the label alone, or giving the cursor a z-index lower than fixed headers, makes the inversion disappear in places.
Positioning the cursor from raw clientX and clientY makes it shake with the hand. It also wakes a layout read on every event if you query the target's rect there.

tunables.name: --cursor-lerp
tunables.effect: Follow factor per frame. 0.1 feels heavy, 0.3 feels almost native.

tunables.name: --cursor-disc
tunables.effect: Full disc diameter over targets that carry a label.

tunables.name: --cursor-link
tunables.effect: Disc diameter over plain links with an empty data-cursor.

tunables.name: --cursor-grow
tunables.effect: Duration of the grow and shrink transition.

reducedMotion: The custom cursor is switched off and the native cursor returns. Rows and the reel drop their slide and zoom and show a faint background tint on hover and focus instead.
